text: Digital ownership interests in private investment funds may fall outside the commodity definition because crypto limited partnership interests cannot be uniform across producers, unlike Bitcoin whose uniformity underlies the CFTC's commodity classification.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Innovation for Private Investment Funds (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2998033

isBasedOn.name: Blockchain Innovation for Private Investment Funds

abstract: Thus, because of a lack of uniformity, it may be possible that digital ownership interests in private investment funds cannot be classified as commodities.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: turns on uniformity across producers as the dispositive characteristic of a commodity
